## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes (lint, build, 100% coverage, packed-tarball smoke test)
- [ ] User-visible change? A line under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md` (Added, Changed, Fixed, Breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (removed or renamed tool or parameter, higher minimum Node.js, older license format unreadable)? Marked under `### Breaking`
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (README, `docs/`)
- [ ] Changes a release, CI, supply-chain, Node.js or test rule? Updated `docs/engineering/decisions.md`
